About us

NZ Post is New Zealand's delivery partner for a digital world. Every year we deliver almost 650 million items – parcels, packages and letters – around New Zealand and the world. And we're darn good at it. Why? Because of everything else we deliver: continuous innovation, an agile mindset, a get-it-sorted culture, and a rock-solid capacity. We collaborate with businesses to find unique solution to their challenges – from streamlining imports for start-ups to seamlessly integrating eCommerce fulfilment into back-end systems for retailers. And behind all this is a world-class processing operation with a state-of-the art Network Management Centre, 120+ GPS-enabled line haul trucks, more than 700 couriers operating out of 26 branches and depots, and three Boeing 737-400 airfreighters. The world has changed – and so have we.

    📈NZ Online Shopping BOOM - Nearly 23% of all NZ retail spending now happens online Dot Loves Data was proud to provide the analytics for NZ Post's latest eCommerce Insights Report, powered by ANZ transaction data, revealing how online shopping continues to reshape New Zealand's retail landscape. Key findings from 2025: 🛒 Online spending surpassed $12.7 billion! Online retail spend grew by 10% year-on-year, adding nearly $1.1 billion compared to 2024. In contrast, in-store spending increased by just 2%. 💳 Consumers are shopping more often and spending more - Online transactions increased 6% - Average basket size increased 4% to $120 - Nearly 23% of all retail spending now happens online Local retailers are winning! - New Zealand retailers captured almost 80% of all online spend and grew more than twice as fast as international competitors: - Domestic spend growth: +11% - International spend growth: +5% - Average domestic basket: $136 - Average international basket: $83 🏙️ Growth is happening everywhere Online spending increased across every retail sector and throughout the country, with smaller centres often growing faster than major cities. 👥 The demographic shift continues While under-45s remain the largest online shoppers, some of the strongest growth is now coming from shoppers aged 45+. 🎄 Q4 remains pivotal Nearly 30% of annual online spending occurred during October–December, with Black Friday to Cyber Monday spending up 10% on 2024. What stands out most is that online shopping is no longer simply a convenient alternative. It's now deeply embedded in how New Zealanders shop every day, across more categories, with greater confidence and increasing frequency. The opportunity is too big for retailers to miss. A big thank you to NZ Post for partnering with us to help uncover these insights and support New Zealand retailers with data-driven decision making. ANZ Aotearoa
